retrospective_requirement: The modified cockpit shall provide primary flight information in installed-aircraft operation.
basis: Purpose of retrofit and installed-flight evidence
verification_method: Installed functional check and flight test

retrospective_requirement: The modified cockpit shall present required engine/airframe information from the revised sensing/monitoring chain.
basis: Prototype cockpit scope and engine-indication engineering evidence
verification_method: Ground functional check and flight observation

retrospective_requirement: Required navigation/communication functions shall interoperate with the selected glass-cockpit configuration.
basis: Retained-navigation and interface exchanges; baseline integration need
verification_method: Interface check and installed-aircraft functional test

retrospective_requirement: The retrofit avionics shall operate from the aircraft electrical system with appropriate protection and acceptable operational behaviour.
basis: Aircraft electrical design constraint plus installed power-related discrepancy
verification_method: Power checks, functional test and re-flight where applicable

retrospective_requirement: Changed or replacement avionics shall allow controlled restoration of required settings and databases before verification.
verification_method: Configuration restore check and functional re-test

retrospective_requirement: Required retained transponder/audio/other aircraft functions shall be assessed for interface compatibility with the retrofit.
The selected retrofit shall be physically integrated with aircraft panels/equipment and the modification wiring harness.
basis: Period integration design record plus retrospectively supplied executed-scope statement
verification_method: Installation inspection / aircraft integration verification as applicable

retrospective_requirement: The integrated retrofit configuration shall be verified on the aircraft and discrepancies shall feed engineering disposition and re-test.
verification_method: Ground/flight test with configuration-specific discrepancy tracking

retrospective_requirement: The selected architecture shall have a maintenance/spares/support concept appropriate to fleet operation.
Qualification and certification suitability shall be assessed separately from functional capability for the intended aircraft/customer context.
Candidate architectures shall be assessed for display/LRU failure response and redundancy/reversion where applicable.
basis: Garmin G900X/G950 reference architecture and prototype discrepancy experience
verification_method: Architecture review and applicable installed test

retrospective_requirement: Display, map, alerting and information-distribution behaviour shall be assessed in the training-aircraft operating context.
basis: Comparison criteria, in-flight evidence and customer evaluation

retrospective_requirement: Engineering and verification evidence shall be tied to an identified prototype/configuration state.
basis: Multiple Dynon/Garmin candidates and changing hardware/software/database states

retrospective_requirement: Public technical claims shall retain evidence provenance and explicitly preserve unknown or unreconstructed information.
